title: Tauranga Gym Deals
meta_desc: Find the best gym deals in Tauranga, NZ. Compare prices, contract lengths, and get up to 70% off with Exercise NZ's subsidy scheme.
intro: Tauranga's sunny lifestyle means gym culture is strong. City Fitness has several locations across the Bay of Plenty, and the area has a growing boutique fitness scene including F45. With numerous gyms to choose from, it can be challenging to find the best value for your money. Here's a rundown of the current deals and offers available in Tauranga.

sections.heading: Current Gym Deals in Tauranga
sections.body:
Several gyms in Tauranga are offering attractive deals to new members. City Fitness is currently the cheapest option, with a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week. Les Mills is also offering a flexi membership with no lock-in contract. Anytime Fitness provides 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide.

Snap Fitness is giving away 6 weeks free, while F45 offers a free trial week. Eligible members can also take advantage of Exercise NZ's subsidy scheme, which offers 40-70% off gym memberships.
list: Les Mills: Flexi membership (no lock-in contract)
Anytime Fitness: 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide

sections.heading: Best Value Gyms in Tauranga
sections.body:
City Fitness is currently the best value gym in Tauranga, with a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week. Les Mills is the premium pick, offering a range of group classes and high-end facilities.

Anytime Fitness is a great option for those who want 24/7 access to gyms worldwide. With the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme, eligible members can get up to 70% off their gym membership, making it even more affordable to stay fit and healthy.

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Joining a Gym in Tauranga
sections.body: Here are some tips to help you save money when joining a gym in Tauranga:
list: Take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme (40-70% off for eligible members)
Consider a month-to-month membership instead of a long-term contract
Look for gyms that offer free trials or discounts for new members
Negotiate with the gym to see if they can offer any discounts or promotions
Use online coupons or promo codes to get a discount on your membership
